text: شهدت مباراة Kingsmoor FC ضد Westport Albion تألق فيكتور كوينلان الذي سجل هدفين، واحد منهما من ركلة جزاء كانت فرصة ممتازة سجلها بنسبة نجاح تقارب 76%[#152]، والآخر من هجمة منظمة بعد تمرير 8 مرات[#222]. نقش رافاييل دلاكروا تهديدًا كبيرًا لWestport Albion وسجل هدفين عاليي الجودة بنسبة نجاح 81% و97%[#401][#553]. رغم أن Westport أطلق 18 تسديدة منها 11 على المرمى، إلا أن Kingsmoor حازوا على الكرة بنسبة 51.5% ونجحوا في تمرير الكرة بدقة 81.3%، مما يدل على تفوقهم في وسط الملعب. التغييرات التكتيكية بين الفريقين في الشوط الثاني جعلت Kingsmoor تضغط أكثر وتعتمد على اللعب العرضي، بينما Westport تراجع لحماية النتيجة[#1187][#1459]. رغم الطرد الذي تلقاه Felix Barros لفريق Kingsmoor، تمكن الأخير من تسجيل هدف التعادل في الدقائق الأخيرة بتمريرة عرضية ناجحة[#1495][#1516]. كانت مباراة حماسية تحلت بالتوازن والمهارة من كلا الفريقين.

social: فيكتور كوينلان يتألق بتسجيله هدفين ويقود Kingsmoor لتعادليها المثير 3-3 ضد Westport!
Westport Albion يضغط بقوة وتكتيكات ذكية لكن Kingsmoor يقاومون بتمريرات دقيقة وتنظيم جيد.
نهاية مثيرة مع طرد Felix Barros وهدف متأخر يجبر Westport على المشاركة في التعادل.

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in ar

- Viktor Quinlan scored 2 goals with an xG of 0.76 (penalty) and 0.278, contributing significantly to Kingsmoor's offense [152,222].
- Rafael Delacroix scored 2 goals for Westport, both high xG chances at 0.814 and 0.976, showing clinical finishing [401,553].
- Westport Albion created more chances with 18 shots and 11 on target, compared to Kingsmoor's 10 shots and 3 on target [team_stats].
- Kingsmoor had higher possession (51.5%) and pass accuracy (81.3%) across the match, indicating midfield control [team_stats].
- Felix Barros received a red card (second yellow) at 81', impacting Kingsmoor's ability to equalize [1495].

- Kingsmoor FC's first goal came from a penalty awarded early, not involving tactical buildup but reflecting their ability to pressure Westport Albion into conceding fouls in the box [#152].  
- The second Kingsmoor FC goal at 12' originated from a rebound after a regain and an extended build-up with 8 passes over ~27 seconds, involving wide play and progressive passing culminating in a low shot by Viktor Quinlan—typical of their 4-4-2 formation emphasizing wide crossing play and patient buildup [#222].  
- Westport Albion’s equalizers (22', 30') were fashioned from rapid regains and direct, vertical passing sequences—7 and 10 passes respectively—highlighting their style of quick transitions into attack and use of crosses, fitting their 4-4-2 direct approach [#401, #553].  
- Kingsmoor FC’s late goal at 82' followed a quick regain and a short two-pass sequence leading to a cross from Mason Morales to Luca Iversen, capitalizing on wide crossing play and exploiting Westport’s lowered line after going down to 10 men [#1516].  
- The tactical changes reflect Kingsmoor increasing pressing intensity and directness mid-second half to chase the game, increasing pressure but suffering more turnovers, indicative of a riskier wide attacking approach [#1187]; Westport Albion then dropped deeper and slowed tempo to protect their lead, reflecting a more cautious defense-oriented adjustment consistent with their style [#1459].  
- High turnovers concentrated mostly on Westport Albion (27 overall), suggesting Kingsmoor’s pressing was moderately effective in disrupting their direct attacks, but Kingsmoor’s higher turnovers (16) also show the risks taken in pursuing wide crossing and pressing strategies [team_stats].
